About The Role
 As a Senior BI Analyst, you will transform complex data into actionable insights that support strategic decision-making and drive business performance. You will partner with stakeholders across the organization to design dashboards, develop reporting solutions, and identify opportunities for process improvement through data analysis.
What you will do
Own the Reporting Ecosystem: Take responsibility for the design, development, and maintenance of the Tableau reporting suite, ensuring high performance and data accuracy.
Manage Stakeholders Effectively: Act as a consultative partner to internal stakeholder, translate high-level business questions into technical requirements and delivery roadmaps.
Bridge Data & Business: Collaborate with the data warehouse team to influence data modelling and schema design, ensuring the backend is optimized for all analytical needs.
Drive Actionable Insights: Move beyond descriptive reporting to identify trends and growth opportunities, providing stakeholders with clear "next step" recommendations.
Standardize BI Best Practices: Implement and maintain high standards for dashboard, data documentation, and quality assurance to ensure a "single source of truth".
End-to-End Execution: Lead the full lifecycle of reporting projects, from initial SQL data extraction and transformation to the final visualization and stakeholder walkthrough.
 What you bring
5+ years in a BI or Data Analytics role, with specific experience in the iGaming or B2B software sector.
Technical Mastery: Expert proficiency in Tableau and SQL. You must be comfortable writing complex, optimized queries for large-scale datasets.
Solution-Oriented Approach: A track record of taking messy or incomplete requirements and turning them into structured, valuable reporting tools.
Communication Skills: Proven ability to manage stakeholder expectations, navigate conflicting priorities, and present data findings to non-technical audiences.
Analytical Depth: Solid understanding of data modeling concepts (Star/Snowflake schemas) and data warehouse architecture.
Desirable Skills: Experience with Python for data automation and big data reporting.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
 About Us
 ARRISE is a global leader in software development and services for the iGaming industry, bringing together more than 2,500 professionals operating across more than 12 locations worldwide.
From concept through to delivery, we combine technical expertise, creativity and industry knowledge to develop products, platforms and services that shape player experiences and support some of the industry's leading brands.
We are best known for the work we deliver for Pragmatic Play, creating and supporting technology, products and specialists services enjoyed by millions of players worldwide.
